obligations.source_text: Definir o contrato que permitirá futuramente apresentar valores consolidados convertidos em uma moeda de referência, sem alterar a moeda nativa dos registros e sem conversão implícita.
obligations.rationale: The shared domain contract preserves native amounts, requires explicit reference currency and auditable quote metadata, and fails closed when conversion evidence is missing or invalid.

obligations.source_text: contrato é consumível por Dashboard, Relatórios e futuras projeções;
obligations.rationale: The documented native/converted/unavailable representation and shared domain export define one reusable contract for Dashboard, Reports and future projections without activating conversion.

obligations.source_text: escolher ou implementar provider de câmbio;
obligations.rationale: The source lists selecting or implementing an FX provider under Fora de escopo; this delivery intentionally adds no provider or external integration.

structural_invariant_closures.applicability_reason: The reference-currency contract relates native currency, reference currency and exchange-rate source/target dimensions, so incompatible pair propagation and implicit conversion require adversarial closure.

entries.plausible_wrong_implementation: A converted value accepts an exchange-rate quote whose source or destination currency conflicts with the linked native/reference currencies, or fabricates a same-currency 1:1 conversion.

read_model_closures.applicability_reason: The issue defines a future conversion representation and validation contract; it does not add or modify a historical read model, timeline, pagination or versioned record query.

canonical_source_consistency.applicability_reason: No duplicate runtime catalog or canonical data source is introduced; the new subpath is the single shared domain representation while existing native currencyBlocks remain unchanged.

documentation_consistency.applicability_reason: The candidate changes the normative project status of the #596 contract from planned to implemented, so living documentation was reconciled against ADR 0013 and existing native-only API contracts.
